title: Residual SNC chart and parameter-tower data
statement:
Let $p$ be a positive prime, $Y$ a scheme, $(D_a)_{a\in A}$ a finite labelled family of closed boundary subschemes, and $I\subseteq A$. Use the regularity and strict normal crossings notions [def-weil-regular-scheme] and [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary], etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism], regular systems of parameters [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters], ind-etale algebras [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], henselian pairs [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], polynomial quotients [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], localizations [def-weil-ring-localization-away], geometric points [def-weil-geometric-point], quasi-compactness [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], quasi-separatedness [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], the compatible prime-to-$p$ root algebra [def-sfb-strict-local-kummer-tame-module], and finite etale schemes [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. Define $Y_I=Y\setminus\bigcup_{a\notin I}D_a$ and the reduced intersection $S_I$ inside $Y_I$.

A residual chart is the following package of data and properties, without an assertion of its existence. It has an affine etale map $V=\operatorname{Spec}B\to Y_I$, with $V$ regular, Noetherian and separated, and equations $t_i$ for the pulled-back labelled boundaries, the vanishing equations being a distinct subtuple of a regular parameter system at every prime. For $J=(t_i)$ it has the identification $\operatorname{Spec}(B/J)=S_I\times_{Y_I}V$ over $V$, with nonempty connected residual scheme; a colimit cocone for the etale $B$-algebras inducing an isomorphism modulo $J$, with nonempty connected spectrum; a geometric point of $\operatorname{Spec}(B/J)$ and a compatible point of this pair henselization; and a ring $H$ over that henselization. Its spectrum is identified over the henselization with the pointed inverse limit of finite etale covers, and $\operatorname{Spec}(H/JH)$ is identified over $\operatorname{Spec}(B/J)$ with its pointed inverse limit. The map $B\to H$ is ind-etale, $(H,JH)$ is henselian, and the residual scheme is nonempty connected and a pro-etale cover. The chart contains compatible primitive roots $\zeta_n\in H$ for every positive $n$ prime to $p$, with distinct root differences units, and the following parameter-tower data for the images of the $t_i$.

In the tower, $n$ ranges over all positive integers prime to $p$, ordered by divisibility. For a commutative ring $R$ and a finite tuple $t$, define $R_n=R[x_i]/(x_i^n-t_i)$ and its root coordinates, including the coordinates of the existing full compatible-root algebra $R_\infty$. Parameter-tower data consist of the divisibility power transitions, the maps to $R_\infty$, their coefficient and generator formulas and colimit universal property; the induced punctured maps and their colimit universal property; nonempty connected qcqs spectra of the base, all levels and full algebra and their punctures; finite etale surjective punctured level and transition maps; and the pro-etale full punctured cover. Empty tuples give the identity algebras. The chart also contains the structural residual map to $S_I$ and the identity-henselization and zero-ideal clauses for $I=\varnothing$.

A residual refinement between charts with the same labels consists of compatible etale base and henselian ring maps, the henselization map, units relating corresponding parameters, compatible roots of those units, and the resulting finite, full, residual and punctured ring maps. Each map is fixed on coefficients and root generators and commutes with the transitions, inclusions and structural maps.
